title: Upload Limit Overhaul
changes: Removed per-file size limits for profile pictures, banners, and backgrounds
The only limit is now the 50 MB total storage cap per account
Simplified upload flow, files go straight to upload without compression steps
Homepage update section now shows 3 latest entries with a 'show more' button for older ones

title: Feedback & Polish
changes: Added feedback submission page — send bug reports and suggestions directly to admins
Added 5-minute cooldown on feedback to prevent spam
Fixed navbar overflow — items no longer wrap to a second line

title: Custom Profile Backgrounds
changes: Profiles can now have custom color, gradient, image, video, or YouTube video backgrounds
Added brightness slider for profile backgrounds
Added option to hide banner and merge it with the background
Per-user 50 MB upload storage with usage meter in settings

title: Markdown Bios & Profile Picture Cropping
changes: Bio editor now supports Markdown with a formatting toolbar
Profile picture uploads now open a crop editor to choose what part of the image to show
Added link warning popup when clicking links in bios
Increased upload limits and added auto-compression for images
